name: Atelier Core
author: OpenAtelier
description: The effects OpenAtelier ships with: color, blur, keying, motion, transitions, text animation and sound.

effects.name: Color Grade
effects.description: Primary correction: exposure, white balance, lift/gamma/gain/offset wheels, contrast, tone and saturation. Edited in the Color tab.

effects.name: Curves
effects.description: Master, red, green and blue curves, and saturation by hue. Edited in the Color tab.

effects.name: HSL Mixer
effects.description: Hue, saturation and luminance per color band (red, orange, yellow, green, aqua, blue, purple, magenta). Edited in the Color tab.

effects.name: Drop Shadow
Color To
effects.description: Replaces one color with another: pixels within the tolerance of "from" become "to" (its opacity is how much). With "offset from original", each keeps its difference in hue, saturation and brightness from "from", so shading survives. With "include alpha", transparency counts too: pixels match on "from"'s opacity as well, and take on "to"'s (turn a color see-through with a "to" at 0 opacity).

effects.name: Invert
effects.description: Flips the channels chosen: red, green and blue by default. Magenta, cyan and yellow flip the two channels each is made of (magenta: red and blue; cyan: green and blue; yellow: red and green); alpha flips transparency.

effects.name: Luma Key
effects.description: Keys out by brightness: the dark parts (smoke, fire or flares shot on black) or the bright ones (on white). Threshold is where it cuts; softness how gradually.

effects.name: Motion Blur
effects.description: Smears the clip along its own movement, as a camera's shutter would: its position, scale, rotation and keyframed effects are drawn at moments across the shutter and averaged. 180° is film's usual look; more samples are smoother and slower.

effects.name: Blend
effects.description: How the clip mixes with what's under it. Add: its light added (glows, flares, fire). Multiply: darkens, white disappears (shadows, paper). Screen: lightens, black disappears (light leaks, smoke). Darken and Lighten keep the darker or lighter of the two. Invert: what's under its shape, inverted, whatever its colors (text that inverts the video behind it); Difference does it by its colors (white inverts, black leaves alone), Exclusion more softly. Overlay, Soft Light and Hard Light add contrast; Color Dodge and Color Burn brighten or darken by it. Effects above it run on the clip; effects below it, on what it blended into. On an effect container: how its result mixes over the picture it took.

effects.name: Duplicate
effects.description: A second copy of the clip, drawn with it: in front or behind, moved, scaled, turned and faded on its own. Its effects: the clip's (inherit), only those listed above this one (copy previous), or none — plus any added to the duplicate alone.

effects.name: Slice
effects.description: Cuts the picture along a line — drag its point in the viewer, turn it by its handle — and pushes the two sides apart (separation) or slides them along the cut.

effects.name: Liquify
effects.description: Melts the picture into swirling, marbled ribbons, like paint stirred in liquid. Amount is how far it flows; size how big the swirls are; detail how many smaller swirls ride on them; swirl how twisted they are; flow how fast they move.

effects.name: Shatter
effects.description: Breaks the picture into shards that fly out from the center point. Parts is how many; size how far from the center it breaks (1: all of it); travel distance how far they've flown — keyframe it from 0 to break it apart. Seed picks another way to break.

effects.name: Bass Boost
effects.description: Lifts the low end.

effects.name: Pitch Shift
effects.description: Higher or lower, same speed. Formant moves the voice's character (child to giant) on its own; "keep voice" holds it where it was while the pitch moves.

effects.name: Echo
effects.description: Repeats that fade away.

effects.name: Reverb
effects.description: The sound of a room: pick a space, or set your own. It keeps ringing after the clip ends.

effects.name: Equalizer
effects.description: Shape the tone: a low shelf, three bands and a high shelf. Drag the points on its curve.

effects.name: Compressor
effects.description: Evens out the level: whatever goes over the threshold is turned down by the ratio.

effects.name: Limiter
effects.description: Nothing gets past the ceiling — put it last, on the whole mix.

effects.name: De-esser
effects.description: Tames harsh s and sh sounds in a voice, leaving the rest alone.

effects.name: Threshold
effects.description: Mutes everything quieter than the threshold (a noise gate).

effects.name: Bit Crush
effects.description: Coarse and grainy: fewer bits, a lower sample rate, like old hardware.

effects.name: Denoise
effects.description: Removes steady background noise (hiss, hum, fans).

effects.name: Fade
effects.description: Fades the sound in as an intro, out as an outro.

effects.name: Muffle
effects.description: Dull and far away, as if through a wall. As an intro it opens up; as an outro it closes in.

effects.name: Tone
effects.description: Adds a tone on top of the sound: a sine, square, triangle or saw wave (or noise) at a pitch, with its own attack, decay and repeats.

effects.name: Tremolo
effects.description: The level swings up and down.

shader.source:
let swing = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(TAU * speed * time);
out = in * (1 - depth * swing);

effects.name: Drive
effects.description: Warm saturation, up to a fuzzy distortion.

shader.source:
let d = db(drive);
out = mix(in, tanh(in * d) / tanh(d), mix);

effects.name: Stereo Width
effects.description: Narrower (0 is mono) or wider than it was recorded.
